therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: BRAF kinase inhibition combined with MEK inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: inhibition of MAPK pathway signaling in BRAF-mutant melanoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with BRAF V600-mutant melanoma brain metastases
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: brain metastasis response rate (BMRR) based on modified RECIST v1.1

results.effect_size: BMRR 66.7% (95% CI: 9.4-99.2) in Phase 2 standard dose arm
results.target_engagement_evidence: Pharmacokinetic data showed measurable plasma concentrations of encorafenib, binimetinib and their metabolites with appropriate exposure levels
subgroup_findings: Safety lead-in phase (300 mg BID encorafenib + 45 mg BID binimetinib): BMRR 60.0% (95% CI: 26.2-87.8)
Phase 2 standard dose (450 mg QD encorafenib + 45 mg BID binimetinib): BMRR 66.7% (95% CI: 9.4-99.2)
safety_signals: 3 participants with dose limiting toxicities in safety lead-in phase
Grade 3-4 adverse events in 6/10 participants in safety lead-in phase
Hepatotoxicity: ALT/AST elevations ≥3×ULN in multiple participants
Serious adverse events including SIADH, pyrexia, dehydration, neuropathy, air embolism
results.dose_information: Safety lead-in: encorafenib 300 mg BID + binimetinib 45 mg BID; Phase 2: encorafenib 450 mg QD + binimetinib 45 mg BID
